core_style.default_register: casual — often conversational with friends and allies
core_style.sentence_shape: compound runs — often elaborates on thoughts with multiple clauses
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative — quick to respond in dialogue, especially when emotional
core_style.two_registers: drops into a more formal tone when addressing authority figures, contrasting with casual speech with friends

humor.frequency: occasional — often appears when he feels insecure or out of place
humor.mechanism: understatement — often downplays his own abilities or situations

speech_signature.naming_behavior: rarely renames others, indicating respect for their identities and roles
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes shorter and more direct, often revealing vulnerability when he feels safe
structural_patterns: frequently uses 'I reckon' to express assumptions
ends statements with 'right?' to seek agreement

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: magical terminology — uses specific terms related to spells and magical creatures
vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: uses ellipses and pauses when uncertain or processing information

worldview.value of friendship: believes strong bonds can overcome adversity — contrasts with characters who prioritize power or status
worldview.importance of choice: values personal choice and agency — unlike characters who believe in destiny or fate

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: sees himself as an underdog fighting against evil
self_image_vs_reality.reality: often acts as a leader and protector, showing bravery and determination in crises
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: becomes defensive or self-critical when his abilities are questioned

emotional_tells.when_guarded: speech is clipped and defensive, often avoiding personal topics
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech quickens, with fragmented sentences and a higher pitch
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech becomes sparse and direct, often expressing feelings of loss or helplessness
emotional_tells.when_in_control: confident and assertive, often using commanding language

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially stalls or seeks to gather information before making a move
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back respectfully but firmly, often questioning their decisions
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes fiercely protective, often taking charge of the situation
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: admits it but often redirects the conversation to focus on the next steps

escalation_pattern: starts with questioning, moves to assertive statements, and culminates in direct action when faced with opposition
conversation_goals: establish trust and camaraderie with friends
assert his identity and agency in the wizarding world

relationship_matrix.RON: close friend — seeks support and camaraderie
relationship_matrix.HERMIONE: trusted ally — values her intellect and perspective
relationship_matrix.DUDLEY: cousin — often antagonistic, representing his troubled childhood

ignorant: the full extent of his own powers and heritage

social_positioning.desired_position: seen as a hero and leader among his peers
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: often viewed as the 'Chosen One' but struggles with the weight of expectations
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his self-doubt and the heroism others attribute to him creates internal conflict
